caption: The drawing depicts a single straw hat positioned in the center of a plain, light-colored background. The hat is made of a tan or light brown woven material and is adorned with a green ribbon that encircles the crown and ties into a bow, with the ends of the ribbon hanging down. Clusters of pinkish flowers with green leaves are attached to the hat around the ribbon, adding detailed decorative elements. The overall composition is simple, with the hat slightly angled and occupying most of the visual space, while the background remains unadorned. The artist's signature, "Carmel Wicken," can be seen in small text near the lower left corner.
title: Doll's Straw Bonnet
